pick.headline: British submarine sinks the cruiser General Belgrano
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of May 3, 1982, listed a long Argentina section: the Joint Staff admitting the General Belgrano was torpedoed and its communique on the May 2 action, Galtieri's address, and reaction to U.S. sanctions.
